summary.text: The story is an allegation of a personal tie between Ted Cruz and Paul Pressler, the Southern Baptist figure later accused of abuse, hooked on Cruz's friendship with him as a teenager. There is no day-to-day development to report: everything sits on 24 August, three posts, and nothing since — the file has been static for over two weeks. @SeanCasten is the sole author and originator of all three posts, so this is one member on one day, not a caucus effort. Framing has not shifted, and no shared language exists. Open questions: whether anyone amplifies it, whether documentation or a news peg emerges, and whether it simply lapses.
